name: River Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description:
River Solitaire is a free solitaire game.

River Solitaire is a unique version of multi-handed solitaire! This online game is a unique take on the classic solitaire game. Instead of traditional rows and columns, this online game uses various hands of different cards. Not only must you match the number but you need to also match the suit. You cannot match numbers only if they are of different suits. There are 10 levels of this mahjong game for you to solve! Each level is timed, so match all of the tiles to be able to unlock the next level. If you don’t make it on time, you will have to start over! If you get stuck, look at your available options on the upper right panel. You can take a hint, shuffle, or undo the last move. Submit your final score to the leader-boards to see where you rank against other puzzle players.
